items.title: JPMorgan hires up to win smaller M&A business
items.summary: The biggest U.S. lender is adding investment bankers to serve clients at the smaller end of the size range, so they don’t go elsewhere for advisory services, an executive said.

items.title: JPMorgan cards chief to depart
items.summary: Allison Beer, CEO of card and connected commerce, will leave JPMorgan for an external opportunity, the bank’s co-president, Troy Rohrbaugh, said in a memo Friday.
